## Author checks

- [ ] I understand and can explain every changed line, including AI-assisted work.
- [ ] I did not include credentials, private content, personal infrastructure, or internal planning identifiers.
- [ ] The pull request is bounded to one reviewable outcome.
- [ ] I tested denial, failure, recovery, and narrow/responsive behavior where they are material.
- [ ] I documented any intentionally deferred work instead of hiding it in a completed claim.
